body:
### Account switch can show stale Perps data **High Severity** `initForAddress` now nulls `initializedAddress` before `init()`, so the address-change path that used to `reset()` channels never runs. In-flight REST fallbacks are not cancelled and can push the previous account's positions, orders, or account state after the switch. At the same time, `handleBackgroundUpdate` drops every stream payload while `pendingInit` is set, including the new session's first WebSocket snapshots, so the cache stays empty and that stale REST write can win.
Additional Locations (1) - [`ui/providers/perps/PerpsStreamManager.ts#L626-L629`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/b762a63f39e40d06c94a5cd11616c9a01852c720/ui/providers/perps/PerpsStreamManager.ts#L626-L629)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit b762a63f39e40d06c94a5cd11616c9a01852c720. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).
action: Reset channels at account transition start to cancel previous REST callbacks; accept initial new-session snapshots after disconnect and clear them on initialization failure.
